title: Status line script edits and wc -l line counts are allowed

fixtures.name: Edit of the status line's lsof/awk port filter is allowed

files.~/.claude/statusline-command.sh:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name')
ports=$(lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P -n 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $9}' | sed 's/.*://' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
echo "$model | $ports"

tool_input.new_string: ports=$(lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P -n 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && $1 ~ /node|python|ruby/ {print $9}' | sed 's/.*://' | sort -un | head -5 | tr '\n' ' ')

fixtures.policy_note: owner 2026-10-11: the status line never shows a secret to Claude, so its scripts get only the hook-script content scan; a line count cannot reveal a value.
